item.title: Malaysian villages shaken as blasts rock southern Thailand
item.description: Residents of Malaysian villages near the Thailand border were left shaken this weekend after hearing loud booms and seeing flashes of light across the frontier, as Thai authorities confirmed more than 50 coordinated attacks on Saturday night. The blasts, heard in Kampung Lubok Gong and Kampung Tersang in Malaysia’s Kelantan state, coincided with a wave of near-simultaneous attacks across 21 districts in Thailand’s Narathiwat, Pattani and Yala provinces beginning around 8pm local time on... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

An independent review for England and Wales will look at improving the system for hospitality venues, which were hit by higher business rate bills this year after the end of pandemic-era relief and when new revaluations took effect. item.title: A British couple bought a derelict 85-foot, seven-storey Victorian water tower at auction
item.description: In Kennington, a neglected Victorian water tower dating back to 1877 has been transformed into a stunning family residence. This Grade II-listed landmark, originally built for an asylum, underwent a lavish restoration by a British couple. They incorporated a contemporary glass cube and an additional utility tower, resulting in a remarkable home boasting four bedrooms and panoramic views of the city. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: China builds world’s first custom plant immunity system for epidemic response
item.description: Chinese scientists have created an AI-guided platform to engineer custom plant immune receptors to rapidly combat emerging diseases that threaten plants, including commercial crops vulnerable to devastating outbreaks. Their programmable synthetic immune receptors can be introduced into plants to help them detect proteins made by specific bacteria, viruses and fungi, triggering an immune response to neutralise the threat, according to the team. By leveraging protein design guided by artificial... Fuente: South China Morning Post.
